title: Swap or wager
dek: The CFTC wants to define a football game as a swap. Two circuits already said no, and forty attorneys general are waiting at the Supreme Court.
quote: "Since 2024 an agency rule is a brief with a Federal Register number on it. Watch the order lists in January. The technology survives. The jurisdictional argument does not."
